messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: latency_p99_chat_completions > 1200ms for route=/v1/chat/completions (model=mistral-7b) — 3 triggers in 5m. pager: @marco @ashley
marco: ack. I'm looking into the console now, marking as on-call.
ashley: taking lead, seeing p99 ~1800ms and p95 ~700ms across us-east-1. traces link: https://observability/redwood/trace/abc123 (may be noisy).
sam: any config changes or rollout recently?
ashley: not seeing a rollout. KV-cache miss rate spiked to 28% on the inference tier, origin RPC latencies elongated.
marco: mitigation plan — temporarily route traffic for route=/v1/chat/completions -> fallback model=redwood-mini (lower mem) for 10m, and add a temporary noise-gate so pager only fires if sustained 5m. Can we execute both?
sam: I can push the routing override now. running: `/infra route override --route /v1/chat/completions --to redwood-mini --duration 10m --reason "p99 spike mistral-7b"`
(devex-bot): executed: routing override created in production — ID ro-9981.
ashley: adding squelch on the alert: change alert condition to require p99 > 1200ms for 5m AND request_rate > 50rps to avoid noisy low-traffic spikes. Proposed promql (quick):
```
ALERT ChatCompletionsHighP99
  IF (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le, model)) * 1000) > 1200
  FOR 5m
  LABELS {severity="page"}
```
marco: sounds good. Also propose per-model overrides: mistral-7b p99 -> 1500ms (higher tolerance), others keep 1000ms. We should document per-model thresholds in the alerts config.
sam: I'll add a dashboard tile for p95/p99 by model and route, and add an alert mapping table. filing ticket: https://redwood/tickets/INC-5421
nina: support note — seeing ~48 customers with slow responses (no errors). I've posted a proactive note to accounts team with link to the status page.
ashley: after routing override, p99 dropped to ~350ms within 6m. looks like the heavy tail was specific to mistral-7b instances.
marco: nice. unroute after 12m to verify behavior?
sam: removing override now `/infra route remove-override ro-9981` — removed.
ashley: after removal, p99 briefly ticked to 820ms then stabilized to 320ms. kv-cache miss rate still elevated but trending down.
marco: handing off to ashley for the 2hr follow-up window. I'll be offline for the next 30m. ashley takes pager.
ashley: will run deep dive: collect tracer spans, KV-cache heatmap, and coordinate with infra. next steps: (1) make alert change permanent with per-model table, (2) add dashboard panels (sam), (3) add runbook section for route override + recommended fallback models (devex-bot please add), (4) infra to investigate cache thrash (assign infra team).
devex-bot: created doc stub: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/chat-completions-fallback and added task to update with steps.
marco: one-off follow-up: reduce pager noise by adding a noise-gate: only page if p99 > threshold AND error_ratio < 0.1? maybe the inverse — only page if both latency AND user-facing errors high. wants customer-impact check.
ashley: agreed. We'll require both: p99 sustained + either spikes in 5xx or request drop offs. I'll include that in the rule.
sam: ETA to land dashboards + alert rule change ~3h. I'll link PR once ready.
nina: support will keep monitoring customers and loop in account managers for any sensitive customers.
marco: thanks team — great mitigation. please capture a short incident note in INC-5421 and include when alert rule changed and routing override id. closing pager for now until follow-ups. :thumbsup:
